description: Work with PDFs directly in chat. Upload a file to compress, merge, split, or convert it (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or images). You can also protect files by adding watermarks, organize them with page numbers, and extract text from scanned documents using OCR. Designed for everyday document tasks, iLovePDF helps you manage files quickly and securely.
